label: Water heater / geyser

questions.text: What kind of water heater is it?
questions.why: Electric and gas heaters need different safety steps.

questions.text: Does your water leave white marks on taps and buckets?
questions.why: Hard water builds scale on the tank and heating element.

questions.text: How long is it usually left switched on?
questions.why: Leaving it on for hours wastes power and keeps parts hot.

questions.text: Was it installed with proper earthing and the safety valve fitted?
questions.why: Earthing and the pressure valve protect against shocks and pressure build-up.

questions.text: When was it last serviced or descaled?
questions.why: Regular service removes scale and checks the safety parts.

questions.text: Have you noticed leaks, tripping, rusty water or a smell of burning or gas?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Switch off the water heater at the wall before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning it while it is on risks an electric shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the water heater yourself; leave repairs to the brand's authorised service.
care_tips.why: Inside there are live parts, and opening it can also end the warranty.

care_tips.text: Don't bypass or tamper with the thermostat or any safety cut-out.
care_tips.why: These stop the appliance overheating; without them it can cause burns or a fire.

care_tips.text: If you smell gas: close the gas supply, don't switch anything electrical on or off, open doors and windows to ventilate, and call your gas or service number from outside.
care_tips.why: A spark in a room full of gas can cause an explosion.

care_tips.text: Have the earthing and safety valve checked by the brand's authorised technician.
care_tips.why: These protect against shocks and dangerous pressure.

care_tips.text: Switch it on only when you need hot water.
care_tips.why: This saves power and reduces wear.

care_tips.text: In hard-water areas, book descaling at a service visit.
care_tips.why: Scale makes the heating element work harder.

care_tips.text: If it leaks, trips, gives rusty water or smells of burning or gas, switch it off and contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: These can be signs of a dangerous fault.

reminders.text: Book a water heater service and descaling check.
reminders.note: Check your manual and warranty card for the recommended service schedule.

risk_factors.question: water_hard
risk_factors.reason: Hard water builds scale on the tank and element.

risk_factors.question: hours_on
risk_factors.reason: Being always on keeps parts hot for longer.

risk_factors.question: earthing
risk_factors.reason: Without proper earthing or a safety valve the heater is less safe.

risk_factors.reason: A recent service catches problems early.
